note: Every season of every sport as the game plays it: what the loader's structural checks do not catch. Errors must be none (scripts/roster-audit.test.mjs); warnings are facts to know. docs/design/roster-audit.md explains each check and the warnings that remain.

name-corrupt.about: a name with a control character, a replacement character, mojibake (UTF-8 read as Latin-1), an HTML entity, a question mark, or a digit outside a birth-year tag such as "Sebastian Aho (1997)" (an esport's gamer tags may hold digits): text damaged on its way from the source

name-spacing.about: a name with leading, trailing or doubled whitespace, or whitespace other than a plain space

rating-range.about: a rating that is not a whole number from 1 to 99

player-repeated.about: one player (by source id) twice in one squad

age-impossible.about: a date of birth that makes a player younger than 14 or older than 45 when the season starts: the record names the wrong person, or the wrong years

name-scripts-glued.about: a name or full name in which a Latin letter runs straight into a letter of another script ("Vitaliy BuyalskyiБуяльський"): two spellings of one name glued together on the way from the source

player-in-two-teams.about: one player (by source id) in two nations, or in two clubs, of one season

age-unusual.about: a player younger than 16 or older than 40 when the season starts

name-unusual.about: a name with punctuation other than hyphens, apostrophes and full stops: a birth-year tag telling namesakes apart, or a source's quotes or brackets (an esport's gamer tags are not checked)

namesakes-in-team.about: two players of one name in one squad (real namesakes; the match shows both alike)

spelling-variant.about: one player spelled two ways in one season, with and without diacritics (the same rating and folded name in two squads)

rating-conflict.about: a name in a national squad and a club of one season at different ratings, with no record of the club layer at the national rating: one player rated twice, or two namesakes

lineup-gap.about: a team the game fields whose lineup has an empty place or a player out of position in goal: its source rates too few of its players

strength-mismatch.about: a team whose stored strength differs by more than one point from the lineup the game fields from its squad

birth-date-disagreement.about: a player (by an id that names one person in every season: EA's, Wikidata's) born here more than a month from the date most seasons give: one of the source's editions has it wrong

rating-jump.about: a player (by EA id) rated 15 or more points apart in editions a year apart: a breakthrough, a fall, or a record joined to the wrong person
